related_primary_sources.title: The Snake in the Box Problem: Mathematical Conjecture and a Genetic Algorithm Approach
related_primary_sources.authors: Pedro A. Diaz-Gomez and Dean F. Hougen
related_primary_sources.observation: The authors seeded one face of Q8 with a reported 49-edge Q7 snake and kept that seed fixed. They report an 81-edge Q8 snake. This supplies a precedent for lifting length-49 Q7 parents. It does not supply an explicit 49+48 construction or an exhaustive catalogue of the 49-edge parents.

related_primary_sources.title: Using the Genetic Algorithm to Find Snake-in-the-Box Codes
related_primary_sources.observation: Results describes a companion exhaustive search in Q7, reports an optimum of 50 and gives an example in Figure 3. This report of exhaustive enumeration is distinct from an accessible list of representatives of all 49-edge snakes.
